verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Mollie publishing a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and a probe of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on every one. The llms.txt index and the .md page mirrors are machine-readable documentation, not an API spec. The MCP server is a different capability, so neither counts toward this story.
